subject: Post-demo: procurement contacts, vendor packet, and PO timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: procurement contacts, vendor packet, and PO timeline

Hi Sofia —

Great to meet you and the HelixTech team on the call today. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed so we’re all aligned: 

- Decision criteria you highlighted: predictable per-token cost, VPC/private deployment option for PII workflows, and audit log retention for 12 months.
- Economic buyer: you indicated James Turner (procurement) will sign off on commercial terms and PO.
- Security/legal: Lena Ortiz (infosec) will run the standard vendor security questionnaire and needs our SOC2 and data flow diagram.
- Procurement path: PO + standard vendor packet -> finance issues PO -> contract countersign. HelixTech prefers an initial 12-month commitment.

Attached is our vendor packet (vendor agreement summary, SOC2 summary, invoicing instructions) and a PO template that aligns with our billing cadence. I’ve also attached a draft SOW to show the scoping language we typically use for pilot phases.

Next actions (proposed):
1) I’ll send a single-sheet vendor packet & PO template (attached) to James and Lena.
2) Aditya will follow up on technical fit items Lena might want in the questionnaire.
3) James to confirm target PO date and whether legal wants redlines before PO issuance.

Can you confirm James’ preferred email and the best week for the PO to hit your finance queue? If it helps, we can target a 2-week window for PO issuance to align with your quarter close.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0211
Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear recap and docs. Quick answers:

- Confirming I’m the economic buyer for initial procurement. Best email is j.turner@helixtech.com.
- Target PO date: we’re aiming for the week of Oct 25 to hit our finance cut for the next cycle; I’ll confirm by Friday.
- Legal will likely want to do a quick review of SOW and standard T&Cs; if you can provide a one-page summary of any non-standard terms (data residency, indemnity caps) that would speed review.
- Lena will run the security questionnaire — she’s copied and will send over a few specific asks.

Two small process notes: HelixTech finance prefers invoices billed net 30 to the main finance mailbox (ap.finance@helixtech.com). Also, please put Redwood’s tax ID and billing address on the PO template — that helps avoid rework.

Appreciate you sending the vendor packet; I’ll review and come back with a PO target by EOD Friday.

Cheers,
James
VP, Procurement | HelixTech

Thanks for the packet. A few items Infosec needs before we can greenlight vendor onboarding:

If we can get those by Oct 16, I can get Infosec’s sign-off in time for the Oct 25 PO window.
